corpus_cross_check.limitation: byte size is a proxy for session length only; it cannot by itself establish a close time, and a day with unusually light trading can be short without being an early close
corpus_cross_check.reads: file names, session dates and byte sizes ONLY; no bar parsed

law: every weekday in the window is compared on BOTH attributes; a match on counts alone would not be a reconciliation

(2018-12-04) SUPERSEDES the 2017-11-27 release for 2020: the earlier release listed no Independence Day closure and an early close on Friday 2020-07-03; the later release lists Friday 2020-07-03 as the full closure and no July early close. The LATER release is used.

sources.conflict_noted: A secondary aggregator reports a 2:00 p.m. close on 2016-11-25. That is SIFMA's recommended BOND-market close; the NYSE equities release for 2016 states 1:00 p.m. (crossing session to 1:30 p.m.). The primary equities source is used.

unscheduled_closures.note: the 2020 COVID floor closure did not close the market: electronic trading continued, so no session is absent for it
